eventName: Fifth Annual ? One Lakh Palm Seeds Planting Festival(11th phase field work )
eventDescription:
The Vidhaigal Volunteer Organization, together with the Tea Kadai Bench Boys Nature Protection Association, is proudly conducting the 11th phase of the field work at the Vayalakkavur Lake.
Nature is the mother who protects us.
We should not remain merely as beneficiaries of her gifts,
but must transform into responsible humans who protect her.
That is the true beauty and greatness of humanity.
